mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting from tightening to easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the prior 20-day average (t-test p > 0.05) during an easing regime, or discount rate changes (measured via FEDFUNDS) show no monotonic decline over the 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, raising discount rates and reducing the present value of future equity cash flows, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than the prior 20-day average (t-test p > 0.05) during a tightening regime, or FEDFUNDS does not exceed 4.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months indicates the Federal Reserve is shifting from tightening to easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the prior 60-day average (t-test p > 0.05) during an easing regime, or discount rate changes (measured via FEDFUNDS) show no monotonic decline over the 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 for 3 consecutive months signals a strengthening labor market, prompting central banks to hold rates steady or cut, which lowers discount rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than the prior 20-day average (t-test p > 0.05) during a strengthening labor regime, or employment growth does not exceed 200,000 for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 100,000 for 3 consecutive months signals a weakening labor market, prompting central banks to hold rates steady or cut, which lowers discount rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than the prior 20-day average (t-test p > 0.05) during a weakening labor regime, or employment growth does not fall below 100,000 for three consecutive months.

failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically higher than the prior 60-day average (t-test p > 0.05) during a strengthening labor regime, or employment growth does not exceed 200,000 for three consecutive months.

failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than the prior 20-day average (t-test p > 0.05) during a weakening labor regime, or employment growth does not fall below 100,000 for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) over 3 consecutive months indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces economic momentum and increases uncertainty, prompting central banks to hold rates steady or cut, which lowers discount rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than the prior 20-day average (t-test p > 0.05) during a weakening manufacturing regime, or INDPRO does not decline over the 3-month window.
